entities.summary: Liparit Avetisyan is an Armenian operatic tenor. Born in Yerevan in 1990, he studied at the Tchaikovsky Moscow State Conservatory and Komitas State Conservatory of Yerevan. He made his debut at the Royal Opera House as Alfredo during the 2016/17 season.
